Rashi on Menachot 108b:1:1.english: But didn’t you say in the first clause - [This question is raised] even according to the Rabbis.

Rashi on Menachot 108b:1:2.english: A bull [worth] a maneh, etc. - And why may he bring two with its proceeds?

Rashi on Menachot 108b:2:1.hebrew: זה ונסתאב שאני - דכיון דאמר זה אקריב עולה, ונסתאב, אזל ליה נדריה, דזה לא מצי למיקרב. אבל התם, דאמר הרי עלי שור במנה, חייב עד שיביאנו:
Rashi on Menachot 108b:2:1.english: "This [animal], and it became blemished" is different - For since he said, "This [animal] I will sacrifice as a burnt-offering," and it became blemished, his vow has lapsed, as this [animal] cannot be sacrificed. But there, where he said, "It is incumbent upon me [to bring] an ox worth a maneh," he is obligated until he brings it.

Rashi on Menachot 108b:4:1.hebrew: גדול והביא קטן - שבכל מקום שנים חשובים מאחד, ואפילו שניהם שוין:
Rashi on Menachot 108b:4:1.english: A large [one] and he brought a small [one] - For everywhere, two are considered more significant than one, and even [if] both are equal [in value].

Rashi on Menachot 108b:4:2.hebrew: ואף על גב דנסתאב - איכא למימר: חלף ליה נדריה, ובאחריות נמי לא ליחייב, דהא אמר אלו, אפילו הכי לכתחילה לא שרו:
Rashi on Menachot 108b:4:2.english: And even though it became blemished - One could say: His vow has lapsed, and he should also not be obligated in financial responsibility [acharayut], since he said "these"; even so, ab initio they did not permit [it].

Rashi on Menachot 108b:5:1.hebrew: ליפלוג נמי ברישא - שור זה עולה ונסתאב יביא בדמיו שנים, דהוי קטן והביא גדול, נמי ליפלוג ולימא: "ורבי אוסר", דלא שני ליה בין קטן והביא גדול לגדול והביא קטן:
Rashi on Menachot 108b:5:1.english: Let him also disagree in the first clause - [In the case of:] "This ox is a burnt-offering" and it became blemished, he may bring two with its proceeds, which is [a case of] a small one and he brought a large one — let him also disagree, and let [the Mishnah] say: "And Rabbi prohibits," for he makes no distinction between a small one and he brought a large one, and a large one and he brought a small one.

Rashi on Menachot 108b:7:1.hebrew: תדע - דארישא דנדר קטן והביא גדול, נמי פליג:
Rashi on Menachot 108b:7:1.english: Know [that this is so] - That regarding the first clause, where [one] vowed a small [animal] and brought a large [animal], he also disagrees.

Rashi on Menachot 108b:7:2.hebrew: ורבי אוסר - אלמא בכבש אסר נמי רבי להביא בדמיו איל, דהוי קטן והביא גדול, דומיא דשור זה ונסתאב, דלא יביא בדמיו שנים:
Rashi on Menachot 108b:7:2.english: And Rabbi [Yehuda HaNasi] forbids - Evidently, in [the case of] a lamb, Rabbi [Yehuda HaNasi] also forbade bringing a ram with its proceeds, which is [a case of] a small [animal] and he brought a large [one], similar to "this ox and it became blemished," where he may not bring two with its proceeds.

Rashi on Menachot 108b:8:1.hebrew: ממינא למינא מאי - שור זה עולה ונסתאב, מהו שיביא בדמיו שני אילים:
Rashi on Menachot 108b:8:1.english: From [one] species to [another] species, what [is the law] - [If one said,] "This ox is a burnt-offering," and it became blemished, what is [the law as to whether] he may bring two rams with its proceeds?

Rashi on Menachot 108b:9:1.hebrew: לא יביא בדמיו איל - דקטן הוא יותר מדאי, אבל יביא בדמיו שני אילים, אלמא ממינא למינא שרי:
Rashi on Menachot 108b:9:1.english: He may not bring a ram with its proceeds - For it is excessively small, but he may bring two rams with its proceeds; evidently, [bringing an offering] from [one] species to [another] species is permitted.

Rashi on Menachot 108b:10:1.hebrew: אי הכי - דממינא למינא שרי, מאי איריא כו':
Rashi on Menachot 108b:10:1.english: If so - That [bringing an offering] from [one] species to [another] species is permitted, why specifically, etc.?

Rashi on Menachot 108b:11:1.hebrew: תרי תנאי - דאיכא דסבירא ליה, דאפילו בנסתאב אסרי רבנן בגדול והביא קטן לכתחילה:
Rashi on Menachot 108b:11:1.english: Two Tannaim - For there is [a Tanna] who maintains that even if [the animal] became blemished, the Rabbis prohibit [a case where one designated] a large [animal] and brought a small [one] ab initio.

Rashi on Menachot 108b:12:1.english: But [if] there is mixing, it is permitted - [Meaning, it is permitted] to bring [an offering] from [one] species to [another] species.

Rashi on Menachot 108b:13:1.hebrew: ורבי אוסר - אע"ג דבכלי אחד אתיא מנחתו, אפילו הכי לא מייתי מדמיו אלא דומיא דידיה:
Rashi on Menachot 108b:13:1.english: And Rabbi prohibits - Even though its meal-offering comes in one vessel, even so, he may not bring from its proceeds [anything] other than [an animal] similar to it.

Rashi on Menachot 108b:14:1.hebrew: תרי תנאי כו' - דאיכא דקפיד אמנחות, ואיכא דקפיד אקרבן גופיה:
Rashi on Menachot 108b:14:1.english: Two tannaim, etc. - For there is [one] who is particular about the meal-offerings, and there is [one] who is particular about the sacrifice itself.

Rashi on Menachot 108b:15:1.hebrew: ובטהורים - סיפא דברייתא דשור זה עולה ונסתאב לא יביא בדמיו איל. ובטהורים, דלא נפל בהן מום:
Rashi on Menachot 108b:15:1.english: And with pure [animals] - [This is] the latter clause of the baraita of "This ox is a burnt-offering and it became blemished, one may not bring a ram with its proceeds." And [as for] "and with pure [animals]," [this means] that no blemish fell upon them.

Rashi on Menachot 108b:16:1.hebrew: הוקבע - אחריותו עליו להביאו עולה אחת, ולא לשתי עולות:
Rashi on Menachot 108b:16:1.english: It is fixed - His responsibility is upon him to bring it [as] one burnt offering, and not as two burnt offerings.

Rashi on Menachot 108b:17:1.hebrew: ודלמא עלי להביא - לזה עולה קאמר, וכיון דנסתאב אזל ליה נדריה. שור זה לדמיו, אם נסתאב, הוקבע לעולה אחד, דאי מייתי ב' עולות לא יצא, אבל אי לא אמר עלי יצא, כי היכי דעביד ליה, דאינו חייב באחריותו:
Rashi on Menachot 108b:17:1.english: And perhaps it is incumbent upon me to bring - He meant: "[It is incumbent upon me to bring] this one as a burnt-offering," and once it became blemished, his vow has lapsed. [Whereas Rav assumed he meant:] "This bull, as for its proceeds if it becomes blemished, is fixed for one burnt-offering," such that if he brings two burnt-offerings he has not fulfilled [his obligation]; but if he did not say "upon me," he fulfills [his obligation] however he does it, for he does not bear responsibility for it.

Rashi on Menachot 108b:19:1.english: One of my lambs is consecrated - [Meaning, consecrated] for the altar.

Rashi on Menachot 108b:19:2.english: The intermediate among them is consecrated - [This is] explained in the Gemara.

Rashi on Menachot 108b:19:3.hebrew: פירשתי - איזה מהן, ולא ידעתי איזה:
Rashi on Menachot 108b:19:3.english: I specified - [Meaning,] which one of them [I specified], but I did not know which [one].

Rashi on Menachot 108b:19:4.hebrew: או שאמר לי אבא - בשעת מיתתו, אחד משוורי הפרשתי להקדש:
Rashi on Menachot 108b:19:4.english: Or that my father said to me - At the time of his death: "One of my oxen I set aside for consecrated property."

Rashi on Menachot 108b:19:5.english: And I do not know - To which of them [he was referring].

Rashi on Menachot 108b:19:6.hebrew: הגדול שבהן הקדש - דמסתמא מוטב שבהן הקדיש, דכתיב: מבחר נדריכם (דברים יב):
Rashi on Menachot 108b:19:6.english: The largest of them is consecrated - Because presumably he consecrated the best among them, as it is written: "the choice of your vows" (Deuteronomy 12:11).

Rashi on Menachot 108b:21:1.hebrew: חוששין אף לבינוני - דכיון דאמר אחד מהן הקדש, לא ידענא אהי מינייהו חייל הקדש, אי אגדול או אבינוני, דהוי עין יפה לגבי קטן. הלכך אתרווייהו חייל, ומיהו לא קרב למזבח אלא חד מינייהו. אבל היכא דאמר פירשתי, ליכא לספוקי, דודאי גדול פירש:
Rashi on Menachot 108b:21:1.english: We are concerned also for the intermediate one - For since he said, "One of them is consecrated," we do not know upon which of them the consecration took effect, whether upon the large one or upon the intermediate one, which is [considered] a generous eye relative to the small one. Therefore, [consecration] takes effect upon both of them. However, only one of them is sacrificed on the altar. But where he said, "I specified," there is no reason to be in doubt, for he certainly specified the large one.

Rashi on Menachot 108b:22:1.english: How does he act - So that one of them becomes permitted to him.

Rashi on Menachot 108b:22:2.hebrew: ומחיל לקדושתיה בגדול - דממה נפשך: אי אבינוני חל ולאו אגדול, הרי זה נסתאב וחיללו בגדול, ואי אגדול חל מעיקרא, נמצא בינוני חולין מעיקרא:
Rashi on Menachot 108b:22:2.english: And he transfers its sanctity onto the large [animal] - For whichever way you look at it: if [the sanctity] took effect upon the medium [animal] and not upon the large [one], behold, it became blemished and he redeemed it onto the large [one]; and if [the sanctity] took effect upon the large [one] from the outset, it turns out that the medium [animal] was non-sacred from the outset.

Rashi on Menachot 108b:23:1.english: They taught [this] only - That we are concerned even for the middle-sized [animal].

Rashi on Menachot 108b:23:2.english: A bull among my bulls - The most significant bull among my bulls.

Rashi on Menachot 108b:24:1.hebrew: מראהו עלייה - שמראהו לעלייתו, ואומר לו: זו מכרתי לך. קא סלקא דעתך עלייה ממש קאמר, דגריעא דירתה משל בית, אלמא בית בביתי לאו החשובה בביתי קאמר, והוא הדין לתורא בתוראי:
Rashi on Menachot 108b:24:1.english: He shows him an upper story - That he shows him his upper story and says to him: "This is what I sold you." It enters your mind [to think] that he means an actual upper story, for living in it is inferior to [living in] a house; thus, [one who says] "a house among my houses" does not mean the most important [house] among my houses, and the same applies to "an ox among my oxen."

Rashi on Menachot 108b:25:1.english: An ox among my oxen is consecrated - [He consecrated it as] a burnt-offering.

Rashi on Menachot 108b:25:2.hebrew: הגדול שבהן הקדש - עולה, וכל האחרים ימכרו לצרכי עולות, שמא אכל חד איכא למימר: זה עולה:
Rashi on Menachot 108b:25:2.english: The largest of them is consecrated - [As a] burnt offering, and all the others shall be sold for the needs of burnt offerings, lest regarding each one it can be said: "This is [the] burnt offering."

Rashi on Menachot 108b:25:3.hebrew: ודמיהן חולין - דקדש אינו תופס דמיו אלא בעל מום שיצא לחולין, דנתפסין דמיו בקדושתו. אבל האי, דלא נפיק לחולין ולצורך קדשים נמכר, אין דמיו קדושים. ולהקדש נמי לא גזיל מידי, דהא יהיב ליה הגדול שבהן. קתני מיהא: וכולן ימכרו כו', דחוששין לכולן, אף על גב דאמר שור בשוורי, וקשיא לרב נחמן:
Rashi on Menachot 108b:25:3.english: And their proceeds are non-sacred - For a consecrated [animal] transfers its sanctity to its proceeds only in the case of a blemished animal that is released to non-sacred status, as its proceeds become imbued with its sanctity. However, this [animal], which does not go out to non-sacred status and is sold for the purpose of sacrificial offerings, its proceeds are not consecrated. And he also does not steal anything from Hekdesh, as he gives it the largest among them. In any case, it teaches: "and all of them shall be sold, etc.," [showing] that we are concerned for all of them [possibly being the consecrated one], even though he said "a bull from among my bulls," and this is difficult for Rav Nachman.

Rashi on Menachot 108b:26:1.english: Interpret it - [This refers to] that which [the baraita] teaches: "And all of them shall be sold for the needs of burnt-offerings."

Rashi on Menachot 108b:26:2.hebrew: אשור של הקדש שנתערב באחרים - אבל אשור בשוורי ליכא לספוקי, דגדול משמע:
Rashi on Menachot 108b:26:2.english: Regarding a consecrated bull that became mixed with others - But regarding "a bull from among my bulls," there is no [reason] to be in doubt, as it implies the largest.

Rashi on Menachot 108b:26:3.english: But doesn't it teach: "And similarly"? - Which implies that the law of both of them is the same.

Rashi on Menachot 108b:26:4.hebrew: תרגומא - הא דקתני וכן, אגדול, דכן דינו שוה, דנותן הגדול להקדש. אבל לגבי ספיקא, ליכא בשור בשוורי:
Rashi on Menachot 108b:26:4.english: Interpret it - That which [the baraita] teaches, "and similarly," [refers] to "the largest," for in this [respect] their law is identical, that he gives the largest to consecrated property. But regarding the uncertainty, there is none in [the case of] "a bull from among my bulls."

Rashi on Menachot 108b:27:1.hebrew: ונפל - אחד מביתו, מראהו ואומר: זהו שמכרתי לך:
Rashi on Menachot 108b:27:1.english: And it fell - [If] one [room] of his house [fell], he shows him [the fallen one] and says: "This is the one that I sold you."

Rashi on Menachot 108b:9:2.hebrew: לפי שאין בילה - שצריך להביא עמהם שתי מנחות בשני כלים, ואין יכול לערבן בכלי אחד. הלכך לא מיחזי כי ההוא דנדרו, דנדר מידי דבאה מנחתו בכלי אחד, וקא מייתי בשני כלים. וקס"ד דאי לאו משום המנחות, לא איכפת לן אקרבנות אי נדר חד ומייתי תרין, הואיל ומכח קמא אתו, אבל מנחות דמביא מביתו, בעינא דומיא דנדרו:
Rashi on Menachot 108b:9:2.english: Because there is no mixing - For he must bring with them two meal-offerings in two vessels, and he cannot mix them in a single vessel. Therefore, it does not look like that which he vowed, as he vowed something whose meal-offering comes in one vessel, but he is bringing [them] in two vessels. And it initially entered [the Gemara's] mind that were it not for the meal-offerings, we would not care regarding the sacrifices [themselves] whether he vowed one and is bringing two, since they come by virtue of the first [animal]; but [regarding] meal-offerings, which he brings from his house, we require [them to be] similar to that which he vowed.
